thesis: The speaker outlines a career spanning 14 years in finance, moving from investment banking to a 12-year tenure evaluating quantitative hedge funds, with the last eight years spent at BlackRock as head of research for the New York office. He describes the fund-of-funds business model as a bridge between large institutional investors and hedge funds, noting that the industry's landscape shifted significantly after the 2008 financial crisis when previously uncorrelated assets became highly correlated and leverage amplified drawdowns.
